UNREACHABLE BY CLICKING, so it is a probe: every checklist step credits on
an OUTCOME event (OnboardingMount STEP_SIGNALS — a brand applied, a page
created, a section inserted, a review sent, a publish), never on a CTA
press. Reaching this overlay in the demo means performing one of those for
real. The probe mounts the REAL component over the SSOT step list; only
`completed` and `isLastStep` are fixtures.
NOT JOINED, and why:
430:2358 countdown-FILL and 430:2361 badge and 430:2372 btn/primary are
all `--flowbite/blue/500` (#3F83F8). Refused, and the refusal is
computed, not taste: DESIGN.md §Color makes #1A56DB the single accent
for CTAs, and white 14px on #3F83F8 is 3.61:1 against a 4.5 floor while
the 3px fill on its own #E5E7EB track is 2.92:1 against 1.4.11's 3.
On #1A56DB those are 6.18:1 and 4.99:1. Conforming would have introduced
a WCAG AA failure on the one CTA this surface has. The board should be
redrawn to `--color/accent`; every other property on those three nodes
is already met in the code (44 tall, 11 top/bottom, radius 8, radius
full, 3 tall).
430:2357 countdown-TRACK — the board gives the card AND the bar 380,
which Figma can do because its stroke does not consume layout. In CSS
the card's 1px border does, so a 380 card has a 378 content box. The
card's 380 is the load-bearing number, so the card is joined and the
track is measured-only. The track itself is NEW — it did not exist
before this pass.
430:2371 next-desc — `leading-[1.4]`. `getComputedStyle` reports the USED
line-height in px (16.8), the board states the ratio, and lib.mjs's
length normaliser reads a bare `1.4` as 1.4px, so this node can only ever
FAIL by 15.4. The ratio IS implemented (`tw:leading-[1.4]`); the harness
has no way to say so. Same for 430:2393 on the sibling board.
Board sample data ("Add your first section", "Set your brand colours") is
not conformed to — the probe uses the real step list, per the founder rule.

countdown-FILL (430:2358) is not a target at all, joined or measured: its width is wall-clock (100%->0 over 4s), so any number read from it says when the browser looked, not what the code renders. Measured it once anyway and it cost a run — playwright's locator.screenshot on the 0-width frame aborted the whole screenshot pass. The TRACK is static and stays.

badge-glyph (430:2362) is measured, not joined: the board sizes it 18, and the DS type scale has no 18 (11/12/13/14/16/20/24) with `gate:design-debt-ratchet` locked at zero off-scale sizes. Snapped to 16 — the same call InspectorEmptyState.tsx made when board 1175:4847 asked for 10 against the scale's 11 floor — which still moves in the board's direction, since 20 is what shipped. The glyph's white fill and `normal` leading are unchanged and were passing; only the size is unjoinable.
